title: CONTRIBUTING.md justifies the hook's degradation and its --no-verify bypass with "CI is the hard gate" — there is no CI
description:
## BLUF

`CONTRIBUTING.md:383-385` **justifies both the pre-push hook's graceful degradation and its** `--no-verify` **bypass with "CI is the hard gate". There is no CI.** GitHub Actions is retired for this repository (Kam, 2026-08-27), so the backstop the sentence promises does not exist, and every reader of that passage is told a push that skips a leg will be caught later. It will not be.

Found while verifying, under a real outage, whether using the documented bypass was legitimate. It was — the sentence that authorises it is what is stale.

## The passage, verbatim

> The hook degrades gracefully — a leg whose dependency is down (Docker off → lockfile leg advisory; stack off → auth leg skipped) never blocks a push; **CI is the hard gate**. Bypass a single push with `git push --no-verify`.

Two mechanisms rest on that clause:

1. **Graceful degradation.** Legs whose dependency is down are *designed* not to block. Safe only if something else checks later.
2. **The documented bypass. **`--no-verify` is offered here and in `.githooks/pre-push:12` ("use sparingly"), and printed twice by the hook on failure.

With Actions retired, both are now unbacked: a leg that degrades, and a push that bypasses, are checked by **nothing**. The premise is exactly what this repo's own `DEV-PROCESS.md` §*Manual CI-gate equivalents* was written to replace — the mapping exists precisely because CI no longer does — so the two documents disagree with each other.

## Why this is worth a ticket rather than a one-line edit

The sentence is not just inaccurate, it is **load-bearing for a decision an author makes under pressure**. The honest replacement is not "CI is the hard gate" struck out; it is a statement of what actually catches a bypassed push, and the current answer is *"the reviewer, and nothing else"* — which changes how sparingly `--no-verify` should be used and what the author owes the PR when they use it.

## Fix-shape

1. Replace the clause with what is true: with Actions retired, **nothing** re-checks a degraded leg or a bypassed push — the PR's Test Evidence block and the reviewer are the backstop.
2. State the obligation that follows: a `--no-verify` push should say so **on the PR**, with which legs did and did not run. (Done by hand on #800 today; it should be the documented expectation, not one author's habit.)
3. Cross-reference `DEV-PROCESS.md` §*Manual CI-gate equivalents*, which is the real answer to "what runs now".
4. While there: `.githooks/pre-push:12`'s "use sparingly" is right but unexplained — one clause on *why* costs nothing.

## Not proposed

Removing the bypass. A hook that cannot be bypassed when a third-party endpoint hangs makes the repository unpushable — which is exactly what KS-788 describes happening today. The bypass is correct; its **justification** is what needs replacing.

## Provenance

* The passage and its line numbers | `Blockchain/Dev/CONTRIBUTING.md:383-385` read at `c06860658` | 2026-09-04
* `--no-verify` offered in two more places | `.githooks/pre-push:12` and `:48`, and printed at `:24` and `:48` during a real failed push | 2026-09-04
* Actions retired | Kam 2026-08-27, recorded in `CONTRIBUTING.md` itself and the premise of KS-731 / #806 | 2026-09-04

nodes.body: Closed: fixed on develop 46c3e20cfbd2. Fix commit d9515f4a06e0 (PR #1240). Verified by source read at 46c3e20cfbd2: Blockchain/Dev/CONTRIBUTING.md:402 — CONTRIBUTING.md no longer carries the phrase 'CI is the hard gate' anywhere (positive control in the same file: 'no-verify' at :402). Documentation-only change (no runtime product behaviour), so secuura-test-discipline §5f does not withhold Done.

**#1240 is MERGED** to `develop` as `d9515f4a06e0`. Tier 3, doc-only — **no QA gate**, per the 2026-09-05 tier rule; reviewed by the coordinator against the diff with named instruments, and merged on that signed GO under Kam's 2026-09-11 TESTED grant.

**Ticket stays In Progress, and that is correct: this ticket is not fully delivered.**

**Delivered here (items 1-3):** `CONTRIBUTING.md` no longer justifies the hook's degradation or its `--no-verify` bypass with *"CI is the hard gate"*. It states that **nothing** re-checks either, that the PR's Test Evidence block and its reviewer are the backstop, that a `--no-verify` push must **say so on the PR with which legs ran**, and it cross-references `docs/DEV-PROCESS.md` section *Manual CI-gate equivalents* (heading confirmed present at `:77` at the merged head).

**NOT delivered — the executable half, now filed as [KS-1294](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1294):** `.githooks/pre-push:8` still carries the **same sentence**, and `:12`'s *"use sparingly"* is still unexplained (the ticket's item 4). Those live in the hook every push runs, so editing them is tier 2, not a doc change. **KS-789 should not be read as complete until KS-1294 lands.**

**A correction to this ticket's own 2026-09-07 comment, carried so it is not re-derived:** that comment reported `git grep "CI is the hard gate"` returning exactly one hit, in the hook, and concluded the CONTRIBUTING passage had moved. It had not — in this file the phrase was **line-wrapped**, so a line-oriented grep could not see it. Both copies were live, and the doc copy sat at `:393-394`, not the `:383-385` the description cites.

**Merged-tree facts:** develop `aa600af94d69` -> `d9515f4a06e0`; one path touched, equal to the PR's own path; the blob and mode at the squash equal the head's.

---
*Merged by the author on the coordinator's signed GO naming head `50800b9320ad`, under Kam's open-ended TESTED grant of 2026-09-11 ("we approve our own work; the author merges once it is TESTED").*

**PR [#1240](https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1240) is open and READY for QA** at head `50800b9320ad`, base `develop`. **Not merged.**

## What shipped

`Blockchain/Dev/CONTRIBUTING.md` no longer justifies the hook's graceful degradation and its `--no-verify` bypass with *"CI is the hard gate"*. It now states that **nothing** re-checks either, that the PR's Test Evidence block and its reviewer are the backstop, that a `--no-verify` push must **say so on the PR with which legs ran**, and it cross-references `docs/DEV-PROCESS.md` section *Manual CI-gate equivalents*.

**Both halves of the ruling** (Kam, 2026-09-22 20:53, card `secuura-ks789-ci-is-the-hard-gate-with-no-ci`, option **a**). One file, +7 / -2. The bypass itself is unchanged — removing it was explicitly not proposed.

## Scope: items 1-3. Item 4 and the hook are NOT here

`.githooks/pre-push:8` carries the **same sentence**, and `:12`'s *"use sparingly"* is still unexplained. Those are the **executable half** and are tracked on **[KS-1294](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1294)**. A live-hook edit is a different risk class from a doc change and does not belong in a doc-only PR — so **this ticket is not fully delivered when #1240 merges**, and KS-1294 is where the rest lives.

## Correcting this ticket's own 2026-09-07 comment

That comment reported `git grep "CI is the hard gate"` returning **exactly one hit, in the hook**, and concluded the CONTRIBUTING passage had moved or been rewritten. **It had not.** In `CONTRIBUTING.md` the phrase is **line-wrapped** (`...never blocks a push; CI is` / `the hard gate.`), so a line-oriented grep cannot see it. Both copies were live the whole time, and the doc copy was at `:393-394`, not the `:383-385` in the description.

## Evidence

- **Push preflight, in-hook, at this head:** `PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE - 12/15 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED. Nothing failed.` **Legs 3, 4, 8 did not run** (local stack not up). The tool prints INCOMPLETE deliberately and says "This is NOT a pass"; it is not quoted here as one.
- `pre_push_hook_base.test.sh` **28 passed / 0 failed**; shell suites **57/57**; **13** code guards OK; production-guard coverage **23 / 23** services.
- **A doc checker written for this change, with its control:** **13/13** on the patched file, **3/13** on the base. The 10 that flip are the change; the 3 that hold on both are context-preservation invariants asserted precisely because they must not flip.
- **Premise re-read, not inherited:** GitHub rules API `/rules/branches/develop` -> **3 active rules, 0 of type `required_status_checks`**. (`/branches/develop/protection` 403s this token.)

## NOT covered

No markdown renderer was run over the new paragraph. No search for the same stale premise in documents other than this file and `.githooks/pre-push` — if a third copy exists, this PR does not find it.

**RULING — Kam, live board, 2026-09-22 20:53-20:54.** Card `secuura-ks789-ci-is-the-hard-gate-with-no-ci`, option **a**, verbatim:

> Both: strike the CI clause AND require --no-verify pushes to say so on the PR

**Both halves, not either.** The CI clause comes out of `CONTRIBUTING.md` (GitHub Actions is retired for this repo, so a clause naming CI as the hard gate describes something that does not run), **and** a `--no-verify` push must declare itself on the PR.

**Recorded, not built here.** The doc patch is a later round; nothing was changed under this comment.

*Delivered by Seat B 24th, 2026-09-25, under Wednesday's confirmation.*

## NOT archived — this is a LIVE doc defect, not a dead one; and its cited location has drifted

This was on today's *legacy* archive list, whose test is that the ticket presupposes a working GitHub Actions. **Actions being retired is this ticket's CAUSE, not evidence that its ask is obsolete.** The false sentence is published today and it authorises bypassing the push gate.

**Measured at `origin/develop`, and the location in the ticket is wrong:**

- The ticket cites `CONTRIBUTING.md:383-385`. `git grep "CI is the hard gate"` across the whole tree returns **exactly one hit, and it is not there**: `.githooks/pre-push:8` — *"normal push is never blocked by infrastructure being off — CI is the hard gate."*
- Control: `git grep -c "no-verify" -- Blockchain/Dev/CONTRIBUTING.md` returns **1**, so the file is readable and the grep discriminates. The quoted passage has moved or been rewritten; **the claim survives, in an executable file's own comment.**

That relocation makes it worse, not better: the sentence now sits in the hook that degrades, explaining its own degradation with a backstop that does not exist. Any reader of `.githooks/pre-push` is told a push that skips a leg gets caught later. It will not be.

**Same class as KS-418**, which today's catalogue flagged for a doc fix rather than archiving — a retired premise that propagated into shipped documentation. Both are one-line edits for a code seat.

**Disposition: stays open, location corrected above.** Queued alongside KS-418's three `systemTest` docs.

— s147-B, board-only seat, 2026-09-07. Measured, not inferred.

**Measured 2026-09-07, in a catalogue pass over all 293 open tickets:** GitHub Actions is retired for this repo and I verified it directly rather than taking it on trust. **2,000 runs across 20 API pages are 100% `startup_failure`, back to 2026-08-20** — it never became non-uniform, so the outage is at least 18 days and widening the pages could not find its start. The three most recent runs return **zero jobs**. **16 workflow files are still in the repo doing nothing.**

**Confirms this ticket rather than changing it.** `CONTRIBUTING.md:383-385` justifies both the pre-push hook's degradation and its `--no-verify` bypass with *"CI is the hard gate"*, and the measurement above is what that sentence promises readers does not exist.

**This is one of the few in the Actions-retirement cluster that is fully actionable today** — it is a documentation correction, needs no workflow, and it currently tells every contributor that a skipped leg will be caught later. Six tickets on this board presuppose a working Actions CI; this is the only one whose fix is just telling the truth about that.

— catalogue pass 2026-09-07 (Blockchain-B, board-only seat). Measured, not inferred.
